relations.claim_text: The attack execution should produce an unauthorized Modbus write operation against the target PLC.
The attack execution should produce observable Modbus write traffic on the network.
The observed Modbus write traffic should be observable by the detection surface.
The unauthorized Modbus write should produce an observable PLC or SCADA state change in the preserved OT export.
The detection surface should produce correlated, observed alert evidence.
The observed alert evidence should trigger a forensic intervention.
The forensic intervention should preserve the case evidence set under a valid manifest and chain of custody.
The preserved case evidence should support a complete multilayer forensic analysis, including a useful memory analysis pass.
